comment: Copy to radio_plan.json and edit. Each slot is one tuner's receive window: center freq_hz +/- sample_rate/2. Give a slot a "uniqueID" to pin it to a specific radio -- copy the value straight out of SDRTrunk's tuner_configuration.json -- so the radio on your 700 MHz antenna always gets the 700 MHz slot. Unpinned slots are filled with whatever radios are left, in uniqueID order, and radios past the last slot are left untouched. lna is the HackRF LNA (IF) gain in dB, 0-40 in steps of 8; vga is the baseband gain in dB, 0-62 in steps of 2; amp is the front-end amplifier. Raise gain for weak simulcast, drop amp and lna for a strong nearby site that overloads the front end. overrides sets gain per radio by uniqueID and wins over the slot's gain, so one radio on a different antenna can be tuned independently of the band plan.
